svg.title: Why Nativue AI
svg.desc: For non-technical vibe coders managing complex software: architecture for oversight, A/B/C roles and parallel views for delivery.

g.text: Build complex software with AI. Stay in control.
For non-technical vibe coders: steer with architecture, manage progress with clear roles.
Keep the big picture. Keep AI on track.
As the project grows, agree on scope through the map.
I can explain it, not read it
You steer. Your agent checks the code.
See what changes, and what it affects
Trace a feature to real files when you need the evidence.
Follow the evidence, not every line.
A / B / C, with clear handoffs
Less relaying. Clear roles and scope.
Split big requests. See parallel progress.
Know who is doing what, and what must happen first.
Check behavior, failures and recovery—not just a reply.
It says fixed. It still breaks.
C reviews in its own context
Built and verified are different facts.
Working parts need a working whole
Test the combination before the user handtest.
Deliver a version you can trace.
New code should not mean an old map
The local service shows changes, freshness and versions.
Discuss the same version of reality.
From one person to a team of agents
Use separate chats or native delegation when supported.
Choose the tool. Keep the workflow.
Source evidence is not runtime acceptance. Background analysis needs a runner; native agents depend on the host.
SienGe AI Lab · SienGe的AI实验室
